title: Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Hinokami Chronicles
description: Adventure Mode Relive the story of the beloved anime Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba all the way up to the Mugen Train Arc! Take on the role of series protagonist Tanjiro Kamado and fight to stop demons from preying on innocent people! Versus Mode Choose your favorite characters and fight online or offline in an easy-to-learn but exhilarating combat system! * Character-specific game visuals created by development company CyberConnect2 Co., Ltd. based on in-game 3D models
